subject: english
title: Noun Stadium App — Person, Place, Thing, Idea
subtitle: Leo works the 8 stations on his own across 13 modules: the 4 doors, noun detective, capitals, the plural machines, the rebels, countable vs uncountable, possessive 's, noun teams, the article gate, and the closing quiz.

content: Sort words into the four noun doors — person, place, thing, and idea — including idea nouns that cannot be touched.
Find every noun inside a sentence without prompting, and tell nouns apart from verbs and describing words.
Work each noun sub-skill independently: common vs proper, plurals, countability, possession, compounds, and articles.
language: Form regular plurals with the four machines (-s, -es, consonant + y → -ies, -f/-fe → -ves), avoiding the vowel-before-y trap, and produce the irregular rebels.
Separate countable from uncountable nouns, including homework and information, and choose between many and much.
Use possessive 's and s' correctly, tell possessive 's apart from the contraction of is, build compound nouns with the second word as head, and choose a, an, the, or no article.
